title: ElevenLabs’ new v4 speech model supports more expression control and 90 languages
slides: What if your voice assistant could finally sound human?
ElevenLabs launches v4 with broader expressive control
It still misreads sarcasm, but now you can tweak it
You can now adjust tone and emotion per sentence
Test one phrase with v4 today; compare to your current
thread_text:
1. Your assistant sounds fake

ElevenLabs v4 lets you adjust tone and emotion per sentence, so you can finally fix that robotic monotone.

2. Sarcasm still breaks it

The model misreads sarcasm, but now you can manually tweak the delivery to match your intent.

3. New expressive controls

You get broader control over emphasis, pitch, and pacing—no more one-size-fits-all voice.

4. Per-sentence emotion

Change how each line feels without re-recording the whole script. Just select a sentence and adjust.

5. Test one phrase today

Take a sentence you use often and run it through v4. Compare it to your current assistant. Does it sound human?

instagram.caption:
You can now adjust the tone and emotion of each individual sentence in a voiceover.

ElevenLabs’ v4 speech model supports broader expression control across 90 languages. 🎙️

It still misreads sarcasm, so you’ll have to tweak the delivery yourself to match your intent.

For anyone recording content, that means fixing one flat line without redoing an entire script. ✍️

Try running a phrase you say often through v4 and compare it to your current assistant — does it sound human? 🤖
